doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: The weekly SNL template and the Sandy Hook children's choir show
summary: Gluck says the show's template is fixed but its content unknown until Wednesday; he recalls an episode with a children's choir and Paul McCartney.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: My tired shtick at SNL is if some artist comes in, some performer comes in to listen to their playback and they’ll say, “This sounds great, this sounds really nice.” And I’ll be like, “Look that attitu — oh you liked it, I’m sorry, never mind, never mind, it was something else never mind something else.” But you know because it’s a very difficult thing for them. I don’t care if you’re the first time you’ve ever been on the show or the tenth time you’ve performed on the show, to go from “Ladies and gentlemen” boom — and hit it live, is tough. Everybody has to be on their A plus game to make it happen. And people sometimes ask me, “Well doesn’t it get boring after all this time?” I’m like, “Look

I know what the template is, I know what the stencil is every week. How that gets colored in I don’t know until Wednesday evening when I get the email that says this is what the music department requirements are for sketches and pre-records,” regardless of the theme, the closing theme, the bumpers, and the musical numbers, I don’t know what else is going to be in. When I was thinking about the choir there was another night, it was after that, it was Christmastime it was after that school shooting in Connecticut, Sandy Hook. And we opened up with a children’s choir singing “Silent Night.” And we had Paul McCartney on that night and he did three tunes and one sketch got dropped between dress and air, otherwise there was live music from the moment we hit the air until we finished up. There was supposed to be live music in every sketch. I think there was even a little bit of music in Weekend Update. So those sort of shows are big exhales when you’re done.
